description: Transport public non régulier des personnes (louage bande bleu, transport rural et taxi collectif) is a data set listed in Tunisian transport sector open data portal (data.transport.tn), a sector open data portal, published or maintained by Agence Technique des Transports Terrestres ATTT. Liste des lignes de transport public non régulier des personnes (louage bande bleue, transport rural et taxi collectif) pour quelques gouvernorats et nombre d'agréments pour chaque ligne. Coverage: Tunisia. The portal files it under the publisher Agence Technique des Transports Terrestres ATTT. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-02-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence with attribution, as labelled on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tunisia-transport-open-data-portal.
